title: Sintel
description: Adds configurable chimney smoke for decoration
body:
Sintel is a mod which adds configurable chimney smoke to the game for decorative purposes.

Press O to access the general menu and P to access the emitter placement settings (cycle through the modes by continuing to press P).

The Sintel mod was created for the [ArdaCraft](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ardacraft) server in order to assist with the decoration of its builds.

However, it can be used by anyone!
